title: fleetline config
description: Lives at ~/.claude/statusline-fleetline.config.json (or $STATUSLINE_CONFIG). Outside the plugin directory on purpose — a plugin update never touches it. Shared by bin/statusline.sh and bin/subagent-statusline.sh (which only reads asciiMode/thresholds).

layout.description: minimal = 1 line (model/context/git). hardened = 2 lines, matches the original model/context/lines/git + rate-limits layout. power = adds a 3rd line with cost/session/PR/effort/thinking/bg-agents/cache-TTL, each shown only when the underlying field is present in that turn's payload.

asciiMode.description: true replaces block-bar characters (█░) and emoji (🌿⬡⚠❄) with plain ASCII, for terminals/fonts without Unicode or Nerd Font glyph support. Also affects subagent-statusline.sh's stuck-agent marker.

thresholds.description: Percentage thresholds shared by the context bar, both rate-limit bars, and each per-task context bar in the fleet view: below warn = green, [warn,crit) = yellow, >= crit = red.

compactHint.description: When context% >= thresholds.crit, append a red '· /compact?' suffix to the context segment, in every layout.

idleThresholdMin.description: Minutes of no new turn before the idle indicator shows (see features.idleIndicator). Not used if that feature is off.

features.description: Small, independent toggles, all on hardened/power only (minimal always stays exactly model+context+git). NOTE: every boolean here MUST be read via the cfg_bool helper in lib.sh, never jq's `//` — jq treats a stored `false` as falsy too, so `.features.x // true` would silently discard an explicit false.

burnRate.description: $/hour + an ETA to exhaust the 5h rate-limit window, derived from two samples of cost.total_cost_usd/rate_limits.five_hour at least 30s apart (state kept per session_id). Shows nothing until a second sample exists.

idleIndicator.description: Shows 'idle Nm' once no new turn (by prompt_id) has started for hints.idleThresholdMin minutes — useful with several terminals/sessions open.

widthAwareTruncate.description: If a rendered line would exceed the terminal width ($COLUMNS, else `tput cols`, else 120 as a last resort), drop the least-important pieces from the end instead of letting the terminal hard-wrap mid-line. Order dropped first: idle indicator, vim mode, output style, add-dir count, worktree (line 1); cache-TTL, bg-agents, thinking, session name (line 3).

outputStyleSegment.description: Shows 'style:<output_style.name>' when present in the payload.

vimModeSegment.description: Shows 'vim:<NORMAL|INSERT>' when vim.mode is present in the payload.

addDirSegment.description: Shows '+N dir' for N extra directories granted via workspace.added_dirs, when N > 0.

clickableLinks.description: Wraps the git branch and PR number in OSC-8 terminal hyperlinks (branch → repo tree view, PR → PR page), built only from workspace.repo.host/owner/name + the branch name/PR number after a strict charset check — never from free-text fields. Off by default since OSC-8 support isn't universal; an unsupporting terminal just shows the plain text with no visible harm, but some people find escaped-looking fallbacks distracting.

agents.description: Background-agent visibility, power layout only. Independent of the separate subagentStatusLine surface (see README) — that one is registered as its own settings.json key, not controlled from here.

bgAgentSegment.description: Shows 'bg:N (w:.. b:..)' from `claude agents --json --cwd <cwd>`. Off by default: each poll spawns a full CLI process (~0.4s observed) — see bgAgentPollSeconds.

bgAgentPollSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between `claude agents --json` polls per session; cached in between. Only relevant if bgAgentSegment is true.

hookCounterEnabled.description: Fills the gap between polls with a much cheaper, approximate count maintained by hooks/hooks.json (SubagentStart/SubagentStop), shown with a leading '~'. Requires: (1) the plugin's hooks are only loaded by a NEW Claude Code session — restart after enabling; (2) can drift high if a subagent is killed without firing SubagentStop, self-corrected at the next bgAgentSegment poll; (3) not available via the curl install.sh path, only the plugin path.
